### Full Product Description
```text
Step into the spiritual epicenter of the Buddhist world with TrueWay, the world’s first offline-first, AI-powered heritage companion designed specifically for heritage travelers who demand depth, truth, and tranquility.

The sacred precinct of the UNESCO World Heritage Mahabodhi Temple is rich with 2,300 years of layered history. Yet on-site visitors frequently encounter cellular dead zones, confusing signage, and aggressive local touts offering unverified myths.

TrueWay changes everything by running entirely on your smartphone without an internet connection:
1. Visual AI Monument Scanner: Point your camera at major compound structures. Our lightweight on-device vision engine instantly recognizes the shrine or architectural feature and opens its verified story card.
2. Citation-Backed Storytelling: Distinguish documented history from local legend. TrueWay explicitly tags every claim as Documented Archaeological Evidence, Scholarly Interpretation, or Sacred Tradition, citing Xuanzang’s 637 CE diaries, Alexander Cunningham’s 1871 surveys, and ASI conservation archives.
3. Immersive Audio Walking Guide: Listen to curated audio tracks accompanying your circumambulation, detailing Emperor Ashoka’s 3rd-century BCE polished sandstone throne, the sacred Bodhi Tree succession, and the intricate railing reliefs.
```

### Full Product Description
```text
Experience the ancient kingdom of Magadha and the cradle of Asian philosophy with the definitive, scholar-verified digital companion: The TrueWay Bihar Buddhist Circuit 3-Day Pass.

Connecting the enlightenment site of Bodh Gaya, the world’s first residential international university at Nalanda, and the fortified mountain valley of Rajgir, this circuit is one of the world's greatest cultural journeys. However, visiting these sprawling archaeological sites independently can be overwhelming, with poor signage and extreme network dead zones in the rural countryside.

What This 3-Day Digital Pass Gives You:
• Bodh Gaya Sanctum: Full Mahabodhi complex, Sujata Stupa, Dungeshwari (Mahakala) Cave, and the international monastery corridor.
• Nalanda Mahavihara (UNESCO Ruins): Navigate Monasteries 1 through 11, Temple 3, and the archaeological site museum. Understand ancient classroom layouts, drainage engineering, and the 12th-century library fires with verified historical citations.
• Rajgir Hilltop Trails: Explore Griddhakuta (Vulture Peak, where the Heart Sutra was preached), Bimbisara's Jail, the Cyclopean Wall, Venuvana Bamboo Grove, and Jivakamegavana.
• Archival Photography Comparisons: Stand where Cunningham and Beglar stood in the late 19th century and observe 150 years of conservation history.
```
